email.subject: A couple quick fixes for Iron Tide Co's site
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I took a look at Iron Tide Co's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no way to book a class or session directly from the site, so interested people have to call or email instead of just signing up on the spot. And the pages are loaded with heavy, unoptimized images, which slows load time badly on phones — most people checking out a gym on their lunch break will bounce before it finishes loading.

Both are fixable without a redesign. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd fix and why.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
